entries.say.variants.default: We're running low on canned goods and spare batteries. Think we can make a quick run up the road?
entries.reply.agreed.say.variants.default: Alright. Pack light, keep the crowbar handy, and we stick to the side streets.
entries.reply.deferred.say.variants.default: Better to wait for first light. Fog's too thick out by the highway right now.
entries.reply.assessed.say.variants.default: Main road looked quiet earlier, but there's always a few stragglers near the gas station.
entries.reply.refused.say.variants.default: No sense going out there right now. Stay put until it's safe.
